Un puits non calé ne dévoile que sa pro: A well that is not tied only reveals its own column. Once tied, it extends its lithology to the neighbouring blocks of the profile (up to faults and province limits). A core (Studies tab, after a well or a survey hole) ties the well automatically and doubles the reach of its lithology.
